title: Structural Pattern Mining in Inka Khipus: An Audit of Clustering and Provenance Classification in the Open Khipu Repository
abstract: arXiv:2607.00185v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Khipus -- knotted cord devices -- were the primary recording medium of the Inka Empire (c. 1400-1532 CE), yet their system remains undeciphered. We audit what unsupervised and supervised learning can say about them, using the Open Khipu Repository (OKR v2.1.0; 619 khipus, 27 structural features). UMAP and HDBSCAN yield three clusters (17/159/443; silhouette 0.82 in the embedding but 0.06 in feature space), and a provenance classifier reaches a weighted F1 of 0.46 under stratified cross-validation. Both track how khipus were recorded rather than how they were made. Cord-level twist coding splits the clusters into three regimes (blank, unspecified/Z, S), and a depth-two tree on documentation indicators predicts cluster membership (accuracy 0.914 against a 0.716 majority baseline). In feature space, a permutation null is not rejected on the full corpus (p = 0.949), after removing empty records (n = 612, p = 0.823), or on a clean subset

translated_title: 印加奇普中的结构模式挖掘：开放奇普库中聚类与来源分类的审计
translated_abstract: 奇普——结绳记事装置——是印加帝国（约公元1400-1532年）的主要记录媒介，但其系统至今仍未被破译。我们利用开放奇普库审计了无监督与有监督学习能对奇普揭示什么。UMAP与HDBSCAN产生三个聚类（17/159/443；嵌入空间中轮廓系数为0.82，但在特征空间中仅为0.06），来源分类器在分层交叉验证下达到0.46的加权F1分数。两者追踪的是奇普如何被记录，而非它们如何被制作。绳级捻向编码将聚类划分为三种模式（空白、未指定/Z、S），而基于文献记录指标构建的深度为2的决策树可预测聚类归属（准确率0.914，对照0.716的多数类基线）。在特征空间中，无论在全语料库上（p = 0.949）、移除空白记录后（n = 612，p = 0.823），还是在干净子集上，置换检验的零假设均未被拒绝。
tldr: 该研究对开放奇普库中619个印加结绳进行机器学习审计，发现聚类与来源分类反映的是奇普的记录方式而非制作方式，且置换检验在特征空间中未能拒绝零假设，表明数据中缺乏显著的真实结构信号。
en_tdlr: This study audits unsupervised and supervised learning on 619 Inka khipus from the Open Khipu Repository, finding that clustering and provenance classification track how khipus were recorded rather than how they were made, while permutation tests fail to reject the null in feature space, indicating limited genuine structural signal.
